claims.nodeLabel: IZMIRAN - Pushkov Institute of Terrestrial Magnetism
claims.text: IZMIRAN is the N.V. Pushkov Institute of Terrestrial Magnetism, Ionosphere and Radio Wave Propagation of the Russian Academy of Sciences, founded in 1939, with research programmes in ionospheric physics, magnetism, solar-terrestrial physics and space weather prediction, and a St Petersburg branch.
